problems: The blind guess (a standing human figure with a raised bent arm) does not match the intended subject. The drawing reads as a hook hanging over a cooking pot, with a curled top, a horizontal arm to the right, a long drop on the left and a pot body below. The guess misses the pot entirely.
The figure is the right way up. The curl sits at the top, the arm reaches right toward the tip near (423,176), and the pot hangs below around y 295 to 445.
The blue outline is a real silhouette, not just a copy of the gold lines. The gold lines run inside it and roughly follow it, so the outline does come from the star shape.

Labels collide badly. 'the back of the hook where it dips' overlaps 'the arm of the hook, just inside', which overlaps 'the hook's tip, from which the pot is hung' and 'the far tip of the hook's arm'. The 'left wall' and 'upper right rim' labels also overlap the pot outline. The text is unreadable in several places.

Star 93805 (the crown of the bend, at about (375,153)) and star 93429 (the arm, at about (399,172)) are close together, so the bend and arm read as one blob. Spread the arm stars further apart along the horizontal arm.

The pot's bottom outline at y about 455 to 470 is a detached wedge (about x 173 to 333). It is not attached to the pot body and reads as stray geometry. Either connect it to the pot base or remove it.
Two unlabeled white dots, at about (107,382) and (168,470), are stray stars that are not in the key list. Remove them, or they will read as noise on the figure.
output.advice:

1. Labels: move each label off the figure into open space, with leader lines if needed. Put the top labels above the curl and the arm labels above the arm, staggered so they do not overlap. Place pot labels to the left or right outside the pot. Shorten long labels where possible.
2. Arm: keep 93026 at the far tip (about (423,176)) and 93429 just inside it (about (399,172)). Increase the gap so the two read as distinct points along the arm. Keep 93805 at the bend crown (about (375,153)) and 95066 at the dip (about (300,163)).
3. Curl: keep 95937 at the apex (about (245,103)) and 96483 on the long left drop (about (213,198)). The silhouette should stay a rounded hook, not a sharp zigzag.
4. Pot: 96327 at the hook tip (about (222,275)) is the suspension point. Keep 96950 on the left wall (about (187,392)), 95176 on the upper right rim (about (293,385)) and 95168 on the lower right wall (about (293,428)). Make the pot body a clear rounded vessel with a flat rim line joining the rim stars.
5. Remove the detached base wedge at y 455 to 470, or attach it to the bottom of the pot body as a foot or fire ring.
6. Remove the two stray unlabeled stars at about (107,382) and (168,470), or move them off the silhouette.
7. Make the drawn silhouette a filled or closed hook-and-pot shape, not a thin outline with a gold line running inside it."]
